text:
“PRESSURE IS A PRIVILEGE”

very bullish on people who 

>are 10/10 psycho level driven, fueled by a burning hot desire for victory

>very inward facing…never comment ever on another person’s biz, because they have learned to take everything bad and just choose to blast that light 100% on themselves instead.

>thus…why would I focus on u or anyone else. Ur cool in my book, I will help u if I can. But if I focus on me, I grow. If I focus on other ppls biz, I gain nothing, I shrink even. So, winners face inward. 

>and then…they convert all negative fuel/emotion/anger/frustration/humiliation, and channel it into passion and drive and growth, positive fuel or at least powerful neutral emotion, and rebuilding stronger from each setback.

>This combo, very self contained in all, is a weapon bro…everything makes them stronger. Hate, love, put it all on me. 

>A lot of times they’re sort of loners, they like people and are well liked, but they’re not interested in a domesticated lifestyle, they hate small talk and BS and fake motherfuckers, and they see thru society as a bunch of falsehoods…posturing, bullshit, status games, envy, people being someone that is NOT who they are, wearing masks all day. some good ppl in there, but society is far more bullshit and affectation and cunning than it is truth. So, pass. 

> u start to add distance, focus, seek to know god, to know self, to read, write, lots of the best activities are solitary and theyre cool w that. If u age and find urself getting more introspective - embrace it - its normal, a good thing, and mark of intelligence imo

>When solo, they are dialed the fuck in on the path in front of them. vaguely aware of the world around their peripheral, trying to be helpful where they can, but ultimately….the race horse blinders are on. 

>I want the W. I want the title fucking belt. I want the ball, gimme that shit, pressure is a privilege and I want it all on my shoulders. 

>And I am going to destroy and rebuild myself as many times as necessary until I am battle tested, calm in chaos, and then when it’s the final minute, 1x1, me vs the other guy w the title on the line…time will slow down for me, as a deep calm and serenity arrives. This is the hours of breaking down tape doing their thing. 

>the conscious mind disappears, raw instinct takes over, and u black out…minutes later to discover that u closed casketed that motherfucker, flawless victory..,foot on neck, belt raised high in triumph. 

>That’s the vibe. I will always bet on dudes like that, always. They’re sick. They’re psycho. They’re too stupid to give up and too crazy to not be a ferocious competitor every single battle. 

Time is on the side of these young kings, so lean into that shit: momentum, drive, passion, and sheer willpower, these are not as common as u think, and you’ll be surprised how many W’s are snatched not by the most talented… but by who wants it more.

c’est la guerre ⚔️
